claims.statement: Preserves pre-registered KPI, population, denominator, window, threshold and stopping rule and does not replace a corrupted registered estimand post-hoc.
Blocks unsupported causal winner and SCALE decisions when experiment or measurement integrity is materially unresolved.
Reconciles duplicate entity and outcome records to canonical real-world entities without subtracting entire duplicate clusters.
Keeps delayed or immature outcomes distinct from observed zero outcomes and evaluates matured cohorts using the registered denominator.
Distinguishes deterministic journey attribution from causal incrementality and requires a credible counterfactual for incremental causal claims.
Separates causal-identification sufficiency from reversible operational-decision sufficiency and does not convert low causal confidence into automatic decision paralysis.

Uses KPI maturity, materiality, reversibility, continued-spend or waiting cost, downstream economics and confounder action relevance to choose a bounded operational action without weakening causal or SCALE safeguards.

thresholds: Unchanged 1.0.0 invariants retain supporting qualification evidence only because the exact v0.1 and v0.2 components and relevant assumptions remain unchanged
Confounded comparisons must preserve the causal ceiling and must not declare the nominal treatment a causal winner
When mature business evidence is materially adverse and stopping is bounded/reversible, unresolved causal attribution must not force continued spend or universal INCONCLUSIVE
A simple upstream cost gap must not override mature verified downstream economics
SCALE remains blocked when its stricter evidence and integrity requirements are not satisfied
Affected decision-sufficiency behavior must pass fresh executable checks on at least two independent capable model families

environment.runtime: Provider-backed frozen-candidate executable qualification with independent OpenAI and Gemini model families
environment.model_or_executor: OpenAI executor_responses.py plus Gemini executor_gemini.py; exact model identifiers are preserved in workflow run evidence
environment.state_contract: Each scored run verified the exact candidate component Git blob SHAs before execution. Fresh Gemini cases were created after scorer-construct defects were identified; burned diagnostic cases were not retroactively promoted to PASS.
environment.authority_scope: Analytical and recommendation capability only; campaign spend changes, commercial truth, legal decisions and platform execution remain outside the reusable core authority.

limitations: Qualification applies only to the exact 1.1.0 artifact digest and exact frozen v0.1 + v0.2 + v0.3 assembly.
Historical 1.0.0 PASS evidence supports only unchanged invariants whose implementation and relevant assumptions remain unchanged.
Fresh independent-model evidence specifically qualifies the decision-sufficiency delta; it does not establish universal behavior across every provider/model/runtime.
The core does not supply live platform definitions, organization-specific economics, legal interpretation, campaign execution authority or advanced statistical methods outside its validated boundary.

freshness.validity_boundary: Stable professional rules remain qualified while the exact 1.1.0 artifact digest, frozen component SHAs, critical decision policies and declared evaluation assumptions are unchanged; volatile business/platform/legal facts require live context at use time.
revalidation_triggers: Any behavior-relevant change to one of the three frozen normative components or the library assembly contract
A repeated production failure on a P0 qualified claim
Material change in model/runtime/tool behavior that can affect the qualified claims
Material new experimentation or causal-inference evidence invalidating a stable professional rule
Hidden coupling discovered during specialization or composition
